# Alika Graham

> Investor and holdco operator. Founder of IMPAKT. Building a portfolio of operator-led service businesses and AI infrastructure.

Based in New York. Background in data and analytics; previously partner at impakt Advisors (acquired by Croud, 2021). Today operates IMPAKT as a holding company across home services, real estate, and AI.

## Ventures

- [IMPAKT](https://impaktlabs.com/): Holding company since 2012. Holdco for operator-led service businesses and the shared AI/CRM stack that runs them.
- [Pink's Windows — Hudson Valley & Palm Beach](https://www.pinkswindows.com/): Two ResiBrands franchise territories. Awarded Newcomers of the Year at ResiCon 2025.
- East Bench Overlook: Premium residential homesites above Red Lodge, Montana. Phase 1 infrastructure complete; Phase 2 in planning.
- [Instant SDR](https://instantsdr.ai/): AI Sales Development platform combining intent data, verified contacts, and automated outbound.
